limits: Read-only: no download, no GUI, no window activation, no input, no write inside an inspected tree.
A passing development build is not a verified package. verify requires --package and reports every required file that is absent, unpinned or byte-different.
Byte-identical native/NSIS outputs are not claimed; hashes prove these bytes, not reproducibility of the compiler or installer toolchain.
Engine and export-template bytes are pinned from the lock and live in the shared cache; create only hashes them when --cache is supplied.
package-snapshot pins prove byte identity with a recorded artifact, not reproducibility from source.
Planned M/N capabilities are recorded as pending-integration and carry no hash.
